title: Lead to cash
objective: Learners follow one B2B deal through the lead-to-cash stages and see which choices add stages and where deals stall on the way to cash.

recommended.why: A 3D walkthrough gives each stage a memorable object and place, so learners can recall the sequence as a journey.

alternative.why: A 3D walkthrough versus a clickable diagram: does the scene help people remember the stages?

assumptions: Illustrative company, deal and stage durations, not benchmarks: lead 2 days, qualify 7, quote 3, contract 10, credit check 1, order 2, invoice 1, net 30 payment
Discounts above 15% need a sales manager's approval, taking 2 days plus 2 more for every 5 points above 15%
A credit hold lasts 9 days and ends when the customer pays a deposit
List price is $120,000 a year; the discount does not change any other stage
Event times are playback seconds for the explainer; days are the deal's calendar days
checkDescription: The approval step appears exactly when the discount is above 15%, the credit hold appears exactly when Hold is chosen, stages run in a valid order from lead to payment, and the reported total days equal the sum of the stage days.

learnerPrompts.predict: Raise the discount to 20% and set credit to Hold. How many days later will the cash arrive, and which stages will be new?
learnerPrompts.explain: Which stall would you attack first in your own business, the discount approval or the credit hold, and why?
